library.about: Neon Drift Arena's production art for the Factory's golden 3D run, mapped by the role each asset_requirement of the arena-dodge archetype carries (player, threat, environment, icon, font) and by id for the wordmark. Models are GLBs the Factory's pinned Blender 4.5.14 built from the model specs beside them (models/*.model.json; build-models.sh rebuilds and inspects them). Read by the assets step through factory.assets.libraries.
